questions.q: What is the volume of amniotic fluid at full term?

options.e: Wrong. This is the upper limit of oligohydramnios.
Wrong. Too high.
Wrong. Not the stated value.
Correct. The amount gradually increases to about 1.5-2 L.

questions.q: Which cells secrete amniotic fluid?

options.e: Wrong. Not the stated source.
Wrong. Not the stated source.
Wrong. Not the stated source.
Correct. The fluid is secreted by amniotic cells.

questions.q: Which function of amniotic fluid permits muscle development and prevents adhesion?

options.e: Wrong. Shock absorption is a mechanical protection.
Wrong. This is thermal.
Correct. Free movement develops muscle and prevents adhesions.
Wrong. Swallowing teaches suckling.

questions.q: What is the benefit of fetal swallowing of amniotic fluid?

options.e: Wrong. A separate function.
Wrong. This acts during labor.
Wrong. A separate function.
Correct. Swallowing trains suckling.

questions.q: Which statement describes amniotic fluid during labor?

options.e: Wrong. Urine and meconium accumulate in the amniotic space.

options.t: It dilates the cervix and washes the vagina
options.e: Correct. These are labor functions with protection from strong contractions.
Wrong. hCG comes from the placenta.
Wrong. Not a stated labor function.

questions.q: Polyhydramnios is defined as more than how much amniotic fluid?

options.e: Wrong. This is the normal term amount.
Correct. More than 2 L is polyhydramnios.
Wrong. This is the oligohydramnios limit.
Wrong. The definition is 2 L.

questions.q: A diabetic mother has polyhydramnios. Which other cause can produce it?

options.e: Wrong. This causes oligohydramnios.
Wrong. These cause oligohydramnios.
Wrong. This causes premature labor.
Correct. Causes: idiopathic, maternal diabetes, CNS or GIT anomalies.

questions.q: Oligohydramnios means less than how much amniotic fluid?

options.e: Correct. Less than 0.5 L is oligohydramnios.
Wrong. Not the definition.
Wrong. This is within the normal range at term.
Wrong. This is the polyhydramnios limit.

questions.q: Which is a cause of oligohydramnios?

options.e: Wrong. This causes polyhydramnios.
Wrong. These cause polyhydramnios.
Correct. Placental insufficiency or urinary tract anomalies reduce fluid.
Wrong. This is not oligohydramnios.

questions.q: Which is an effect of oligohydramnios?

options.e: Correct. Low fluid causes adhesions and malformations.
Wrong. This is an effect of polyhydramnios.
Wrong. This is associated with polyhydramnios.
Wrong. Not a stated effect.

questions.q: What is the effect of premature rupture of the amnion?

options.e: Wrong. Opposite effect.
Correct. Rupture leads to premature labor.
Wrong. Not the stated effect.
Wrong. Unrelated.

questions.q: Which structure develops on the 9th day and what is its origin?

options.e: Wrong. Not the 9th-day structure.
Correct. The primary yolk sac forms from the blastocele.
Wrong. The allantois forms from the hindgut later.
Wrong. Not correct.

questions.q: What does the blastocele become?

options.e: Wrong. The secondary yolk sac forms after pinching off.
Wrong. This forms separately in the epiblast.
Wrong. Not the stated fate.
Correct. The blastocele becomes the primary yolk sac.

questions.q: Which structure forms when the primary yolk sac is pinched off at the end of the 2nd week?

options.e: Wrong. This forms after folding.
Correct. This follows pinching off.
Wrong. The allantois arises from the hindgut.
Wrong. This is a stalk after folding.

questions.q: After folding, which three derivatives come from the yolk sac?

options.e: Wrong. The amnion and allantois are not yolk sac derivatives.
Wrong. Not yolk sac derivatives.

options.t: Gut, definitive yolk sac and vitelline duct
options.e: Correct. These are the stated derivatives.
Wrong. Not yolk sac derivatives.

questions.q: Which structure extends from the hindgut into the umbilical cord?

options.e: Correct. The allantois extends from the hindgut.
Wrong. This connects midgut and yolk sac.
Wrong. This forms during notochord formation.
Wrong. The urachus is the later remnant of the allantois.

questions.q: Which cells appear in the wall of the yolk sac?

options.e: Correct. They are found in the yolk sac wall.
Wrong. Not the stated cells.
Wrong. Not the stated cells.
Wrong. Not the stated cells.

questions.q: Which term describes the endometrium of the pregnant uterus?

options.e: Wrong. The chorion is an embryonic membrane.
Wrong. The amnion surrounds the amniotic cavity.
Correct. The decidua is the pregnant endometrium.
Wrong. The trophoblast is the outer cell layer of the blastocyst.

questions.q: Which list gives the placenta's endocrine products?

options.t: hCG, estrogen, progesterone, melanin spreading factor, somatomammotropin
options.e: Correct. These are the stated endocrine functions.
Wrong. Not placental products.
Wrong. Not placental products.
Wrong. Not the stated list.

questions.q: Which umbilical cord finding is a structural anomaly?

options.e: Wrong. This is the anterior wall anomaly.
Wrong. This is the knot anomaly.
Correct. This is the structural anomaly listed.
Wrong. This is an attachment abnormality of the placenta.
